tolerance.note: every frame bitwise (running FNV-1a of the probe + packed palettes); rows locate the first divergent field

setup.heliFormula: t = frame/60; x = x0 + ax·sin(t·wx), y = y0 + ay·sin(t·wy), z = z0 + az·sin(t·wz); ctx.heli = {position, altitude: y}; set BEFORE the frame's actions and update
setup.look: Look(7) (Resources/Textures atlas), uniforms zeroed; weather writes setWind/setFronts/uRain/uWet/uFlash/uNight
setup.env: PMREM replaced by a recorder: every bake logs [frame, uSky rgb, uFog rgb, uDeep rgb, uSunColor rgb, uSunDir xyz, uSunI, uCloud]
setup.order: new Weather(ctx) (mode, settings, params); actions of frame -1; init(); per frame f: heli/camera, actions of f (in order), update(dt)

data.hashNote: h0 = 2166136261; h = fnv1a32(h, bytes of probe row ++ _from ++ _cur ++ _out as f64 LE) after every frame (hashEvery 1) or after frames (i+1)·hashEvery − 1 only; hashes[i] = h after frame (i+1)·hashEvery − 1
data.firstFrameNote: probe row and packed palettes after frame 0 (diagnostics for a hash mismatch)
